name: How long does deck resurfacing take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does deck resurfacing take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of deck resurfacing depends on the deck's size, its current condition, the weather, and the type of finish being applied. A smaller deck with minimal damage might take a few days, while a larger, more complex project with extensive repairs could take over a week. Factors like drying times for stains and sealants also influence the timeline. Hometelligent Inc. strives to provide a clear project timeline upfront, considering local weather patterns common in our Alameda service areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Resurfacing time varies by deck size, condition, and weather, typically from a few days to over a week, depending on repair and finish types.
